gate.name: Full gate (check, e2e) on PR head merged with main

runner.description: Where to run (self-hosted = the owner's runner, label stcc)

checkout.name: Check the inputs and that the pull request's head is in this repository
checkout.run:
[[ "$PR" =~ ^[0-9]+$ && "$SHA" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]] || { echo "::error::bad inputs"; exit 1; }
curl -sSf -H "Authorization: Bearer $GH_TOKEN" -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" \
  "https://api.github.com/repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/pulls/$PR" > pr.json
python3 - "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" "$SHA" <<'PY'
import json, sys
pr = json.load(open('pr.json', encoding='utf-8'))
repo, sha = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
head = pr['head']
if (head.get('repo') or {}).get('full_name') != repo:
    sys.exit(f"::error::the head of PR #{pr['number']} is not in {repo}: refused")
if head['sha'] != sha:
    sys.exit(f"::error::PR #{pr['number']} head is {head['sha']}, expected {sha}")
PY
rm pr.json

prepare.name: Merge the pull request's head into main (what the pull_request event tests)
prepare.run:
git fetch -q origin "pull/$PR/head:pr-head"
head=$(git rev-parse pr-head)
[ "$head" = "$SHA" ] || { echo "::error::PR #$PR head is $head, expected $SHA"; exit 1; }
git -c user.name=full-gate -c user.email=full-gate@invalid merge -q --no-edit pr-head
echo "Tested $(git rev-parse --short HEAD) = main $(git rev-parse --short origin/main) + PR #$PR head ${SHA:0:7}" | tee -a "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

browsers.name: Playwright's Chromium
browsers.run:
if sudo -n true 2>/dev/null; then npx playwright install --with-deps chromium
else npx playwright install chromium
fi

prepare.name: Guard - media/photos is checked out in full (the pictures e2e needs)
prepare.run:
want=$(git ls-files media/photos | wc -l)
have=$(find media/photos -type f 2>/dev/null | wc -l)
if [ ! -d media/photos ] || [ "$want" -eq 0 ] || [ "$have" -lt "$want" ]; then
  echo "::error::media/photos is missing or incomplete ($have of $want files): the Full gate needs a full checkout (BUILD_PLAN 4.12)"
  exit 1
fi
echo "media/photos: $have of $want files present"

install.name: Python for the face tests - can the runner's python3 make the virtual environment?
install.run:
rm -rf "$RUNNER_TEMP/faces-venv"
if python3 -c 'import sys; sys.exit(sys.version_info < (3, 12))' 2>/dev/null &&
  python3 -m venv "$RUNNER_TEMP/faces-venv" 2>/dev/null; then
  echo "setup=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
  echo "the runner's $(python3 --version)"
else
  rm -rf "$RUNNER_TEMP/faces-venv"
  echo "setup=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
  echo "the runner's python3 is missing, older than 3.12 or has no venv: actions/setup-python"
fi

install.name: Python for the face tests - numpy and Pillow (scripts/faces/requirements.txt)
install.run:
venv="$RUNNER_TEMP/faces-venv"
[ -x "$venv/bin/python" ] || python3 -m venv "$venv"
"$venv/bin/python" -m pip install -q --disable-pip-version-check -r scripts/faces/requirements.txt
"$venv/bin/python" -c 'import sys, numpy, PIL; print(sys.version.split()[0], "numpy", numpy.__version__, "Pillow", PIL.__version__)'
echo "PYTHON=$venv/bin/python" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
